pca.fit_scope: unique covered training-content bins; auxiliary transforms on unique training-content windows

primary_metric: mean across eight targets of training-scale-normalized MAE; equal lecture then observed person then window; pooled out-of-fold rows
negative_control: seeded nonzero cyclic reassignment of all eight training targets together within each viewing; held targets unchanged

bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive; only four previously observed lessons

missing_modality_policy: zero transformed unavailable blocks with explicit masks; never zero-fill missing time within a present modality
auxiliary_dropout: mask auxiliary window features whenever any available temporal modality is dropped; no leaked alternate representation of a deliberately dropped input

fallback.model: fixed ridge on existing window features for all non-mean arms
